Investors Joshua Higa ir@ultragenyx.com Media Jess Rowlands media@ultragenyx.com Ultragenyx Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Update Second quarter total revenue of $214 million, Crysvita® revenue of $156 million and Dojolvi® revenue of $27 million Reaffirm 2026 financial guidance, including total revenue of $730 million to $760 million and combined R&D and SG&A expenses to be flat to slightly down versus 2025; remain on path to profitability in 2027 Catalysts in second half of 2026 include two PDUFA dates and pivotal data readout from GTX-102 Phase 3 Aspire study for Angelman syndrome NOVATO, Calif. – August 4, 2026 – Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc.
We are ready to launch two gene therapy products and are preparing for a pivotal Phase 3 GTX-102 data readout in Angelman syndrome.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) accepted for review the Biologics License Application (BLA) seeking approval of DTX401 as a treatment for GSDIa and assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) action date of August 23, 2026.

• UX111 (rebisufligene etisparvovec) AAV9 gene therapy for the treatment of Sanfilippo syndrome type A (MPS IIIA): In April 2026, the FDA accepted for review the resubmitted BLA seeking accelerated approval for UX111 as a treatment for MPS IIIA and assigned a PDUFA action date of September 19, 2026.
